overview: This Senate resolution congratulates the Carolina Hurricanes, a National Hockey League team based in Raleigh, North Carolina, for winning the 2026 Stanley Cup, hockey's championship trophy. It notes the team beat the Vegas Golden Knights four games to two in the final series, finishing the playoffs with a 16-3 record, and that this is the team's second title, 20 years after its first. It recognizes the head coach, the team captain who was named most valuable player of the playoffs, and the team's community programs. The resolution is ceremonial and does not change any law. As of July 14, 2026, the Senate had approved it.
for: Supporters say it is a fitting way to honor a hometown team's achievement and the pride it brought to fans across the Carolinas.
against: Critics say it is symbolic, does not change any law or spending, and uses Senate time on sports congratulations.
